name: Tsuyoane
source:
Main character has a strong and strict sister who scolds him all the time for behavior and poor grades. And he so wants to please her. This thought eventually overwhelms him and sneaks into her bedroom at night.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角有一个坚强而严格的妹妹，总是因为他的行为和糟糕成绩责骂他。他非常渴望得到妹妹的认可，这种愿望最终压倒了理智，让他在夜里溜进她的卧室。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]]
